frozen_admission_criteria.family_independence: candidate must not be a Pi0.5/OpenPI derivative or GR00T N1.7 derivative if it is to count as the third policy family
frozen_admission_criteria.behavior_interface: publicly documented path must consume BEHAVIOR 2026 allowed observations and emit actions compatible with the official evaluator/R1Pro or an explicitly frozen supported robot config
frozen_admission_criteria.training_contract: public training/data adapter must support the 2026 challenge dataset or expose a deterministic, preregistrable adapter without outcome-conditioned task selection
frozen_admission_criteria.serving_contract: public serving path must be bridgeable to the official BEHAVIOR websocket evaluator without using privileged evaluation inputs
frozen_admission_criteria.checkpoint_or_recipe_provenance: either a public challenge-compatible checkpoint or a complete source-pinned training recipe whose checkpoint-selection rule can be frozen before outcome access

third_family_candidates.reason: the project explicitly states that the policy is based on Pi0.5 and built on OpenPI; its BEHAVIOR engineering completeness does not make it an independent policy family
public SmolVLA documentation provides generic LeRobot fine-tuning but no verified BEHAVIOR 2026 R1Pro observation/action adapter and evaluator-serving contract
public training/evaluation paths target LIBERO and ALOHA; no source-qualified BEHAVIOR 2026 R1Pro adapter/serve contract was found before outcome access

decision.reason: the three-family requirement was frozen before outcome access; the absence of a convenient third official baseline is not evidence for reducing the evidentiary requirement
decision.next_gate: a genuinely independent policy family must acquire a source-pinned BEHAVIOR 2026 interface, training, serving, and checkpoint-selection contract before any policy training or rollout authority is considered

allowed_now: complete source-pinned training/evaluation contracts for the two official families
monitor public challenge baselines/results for a new independent family
qualify a third family using only interface/code/checkpoint provenance
estimate data/compute requirements without loading scientific outcomes
forbidden_now: counting a Pi0.5 derivative as an independent third family
building a BEHAVIOR adapter for SmolVLA/OpenVLA-OFT and then counting that engineering work as pre-existing independent evidence
selecting the third family after seeing BEHAVIOR outcomes
